outcome: adverse perinatal outcomes (composite of maternal and neonatal adverse events)
cohort: The study included 385 cases of early-gestational diabetes mellitus, diagnosed before 20 weeks of gestation based on specific oral glucose tolerance test criteria.
finding: In early-gestational diabetes mellitus, pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity and fasting plasma glucose levels between 95-125 mg/dL were significantly associated with a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
gest_age: Diagnosis of early-GDM made before 20 weeks of gestation.
